input.quote: ARTICLE XXII RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL During the term of this Agreement, the Licensor shall have the right (the "Right of First Refusal"), for a period (the "Exercise Period") expiring at 11:59 PM (Eastern Time) on the fifth (5th) business day after the giving of written notice by the Licensee that it has received a bonafide offer from a third party to (ii) purchase all or substantially all of the assets of Licensee
input.rationale: Pricing is set by the per-ticket volume tiers (p0056-p0067) and Supplemental Payments (p0078) with no best-terms undertaking, and there is no MFN in either direction on fees. However, Article XXII imposes a right-to-match / most-favoured-offer mechanic on us: we must disclose any bonafide third-party offer for our assets or a merger and give the Licensor a first-refusal window before we may proceed (p0139-p0141). Under the playbook that disclosure/right-to-match mechanic is an MFN-type obligation burdening the Customer, and it fails every fallback element: it is not limited to a defined product, it runs for the whole term (36 months, extendable seven years at the Licensor's option per p0049) rather than 12 months, and it has no like-for-like comparison carve-outs. We therefore take the preferred position and remove the obligation, keeping our right to consummate the third-party transaction. The related Change of Control consent right (p0134) is a separate mechanic and is not flagged here.

proposal.summary: Remove the Licensor's right of first refusal / right to match third-party offers to Licensee
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have removed the Licensor's Article XXII right of first refusal over bonafide third-party offers, as our position is that we take on no most-favoured or right-to-match obligation in the Licensor's favour, and conformed the follow-on sentence so we remain free to consummate the transaction. If some mechanic is needed, we could consider one limited to a defined product, capped at 12 months and with like-for-like comparison carve-outs.

ops.oldText: ARTICLE XXII RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL During the term of this Agreement, the Licensor shall have the right (the "Right of First Refusal"), for a period (the "Exercise Period") expiring at 11:59 PM (Eastern Time) on the fifth (5th) business day after the giving of written notice by the Licensee that it has received a bonafide offer from a third party to (ii) purchase all or substantially all of the assets of Licensee; or (ii) to engage in a merger or consolidation in which Licensee is not the surviving corporation or in which, if Licensee is the surviving corporation, the owners of Licensee immediately prior to the consummation of such merger or consolidation do not, immediately after consummation of such merger or consolidation, own stock or other securities of Licensee that possess a majority of the voting power of all Licensee's outstanding stock and other securities and the power to elect a majority of the members of Licensee's board of directors.
ops.newText: ARTICLE XXII NO RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL The Licensor shall have no right of first refusal, right to match or similar right with respect to any offer received by the Licensee from a third party.
